precision: bfloat16 weights and matmuls; float32 cross entropy
objective: Mean next-token NLL in nats/token; raw text; no chat template, BOS or EOS; first token unscored
sampling: 1000 unique current random English Wikipedia article IDs with current wikitext >=10000 characters; latest revision before 2020; seeded eligible paragraph start with 750 contiguous transcript words. Conditional on survival, source length and clean-window eligibility.
provenance: Saved historical revision wikitext and mwparserfromhell transcript; literal transcript substrings with offsets and SHA256. Template removal can join text. Pre2020 wording does not establish exclusive human authorship or Qwen training inclusion.
benchmark: Tune 256 length-stratified samples, including longest. Two warmed repeats per setting; then three full 1000-sample scoring trials. Includes padding, device transfers and loss reduction; excludes collection, model loading and tokenization. No NLL result cache.
selection: NLL only; AI_STYLE_RUBRIC.md 0.1.0 consulted; style resemblance not scored. No Pangram calls. 750-word scoring deferred.
